items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Yeah, he played with, with, with, with, with this, with this group out of Spanish Forte for a while

ctx.x: You know? I mean, uh, that, that, that style, of course, when I, when I hear anything, walking down the street, I hear a band, and I, I listen for a while, and all of a sudden, they're all trying to copy him, or, and it's this new style playing, playing, uh, silly, silly type of funny hat music, whatever you want to call it. Mm-hmm. Uh, I mean, I don't, I don't know how to explain, but, uh, it's a different world today. I don't, I don't know whether, whether, whether, whether I'm right or wrong, but, but I like…
Oh, yeah. Well, what about, uh, did you know Johnny Miller, the piano player in New Orleans?

Yeah, he played with, with, with, with, with this, with this group out of Spanish Forte for a while, see, before, before Joe Wolf came with the band, see. And, uh, he's the guy that, that, that was on, on, I thought, a trip around, uh, when we first started, started the band when I joined Johnny, see, because at that time they had, they had, uh, I don't know, what, Skaglone was playing, Clannad, no, no, uh, Bill Kriegel, I don't remember the guy that, that was in his band, I think Dan Tagner played, of course,…
